audit.qualification: Three rotated repetitions of the unchanged16-workload diagnostic pilot. All raw samples, unfavorable changes, result/mode checks, startup/total/RSS/GC evidence retained. Original source284, correctness-only source287 and optimized source286 are separate. Emaxx allocation counters remain explicitly unavailable. These are not calibrated nine-round/three-sample measurements and cannot establish the locked3% acceptance criterion or universal correctness.

profiles.qualification: Separate2-second macOS sample profiles at1ms intervals, Emaxx running20 repetitions; prior separately retained GNU profiles remain the reference, using of the unchanged locked-size body. Instrumented durations are not performance evidence. All raw reports, process outcomes and sample trees are retained; no local full-validation job ran concurrently.

scope.qualification: Three rotated repetitions of unchanged16-case pilot across original284, corrected287 and optimized286. Retains every favorable and unfavorable sample. The original benchmark preflight KeyError ran no process; its corrected helper uses the original separate measurement-input manifest. No runtime, workload, timeout, expected answer or tolerance changed to fit timings. Real allocation counters and calibrated nine-round performance criterion remain unsatisfied. Profiles are separate from timing.
